---
name: wake-spending-tracker
description: Maintain local wake-up and spending records and visualize wake-time trends without publishing personal data.
---

# Wake & Spending Tracker

1. Keep real records only in local, ignored files.
2. Store wake times as `HH:MM` and spending as integer TWD.
3. When adding an expense, update the existing date rather than creating duplicate rows.
4. Recalculate the monthly total after every expense change.
5. Never commit personal dates, times, amounts, names, paths, or account identifiers.
6. Use synthetic data only in public examples and demos.
